event.title: Cleveland Pickle Fest 2026
event.description: Cleveland Pickle Fest is back! Join Great Lakes Brewing Co. and Greater Cleveland Volunteers on Saturday, October 3 at Mall C in Downtown Cleveland for a full day celebrating all things pickles and volunteerism. As the Official Beer Sponsor, we’ll be pouring a lineup of GLBC favorites and pickle-inspired brews, including Midwest IPA, Oktoberfest, Pickle Pilsner and Spicy Pickle Pilsner, Cold Rush, and aSPLASH crafted citrus long drinks. Pickle lovers can enjoy a variety of pickle-filled food and drinks throughout the festival, including pickle pizza, pickle candy, pickle ice cream, and pickles on a stick. Live music will keep the festival going all day, with performances from DJ JT, Böaterhead, and Jasmin Jeanise. What: Cleveland Pickle Fest, Sponsored by Great Lakes Brewing Co. Where: Cleveland Mall C When: October 3

event.title: Haunted History Tours
event.description: On these special Halloween Brewery Tours, join one of our tour guides for a haunting journey through our iconic brewpub buildings, all with a beer in hand. Explore the history of these buildings that now make up our brewpub, and hear the stories of the ghosts that still haunt them (along with some spooky Cleveland tales). Tours last approximately 45-60 minutes, and include your first beer in the pub, plus a tour pint glass to take home! Tours will meet in the gift shop for check-in before venturing into the brewpub to grab your first beer and explore our 19th century historic buildings with your tour guide. The Fine Print Haunted History Tours will only take place in our brewpub and will not enter our main production facility. For our year-round brewery tours, please visit our website at https://www.greatlakesbrewing.com/tours-and-classes/. Choose your tour date and time carefully! Payment is non-refundable, and event date and time is non-transferable. Our tours start promptly at their scheduled time; no exceptions. Guests arriving late are not guaranteed a chance to join their tour. Please allow time to find parking and arrive at least 10 minutes before your scheduled tour start time. Don’t forget your ID! Guests must be 21 or older with a valid ID to consume or purchase alcohol. Guests without a valid ID at check-in will not receive beer. One beer in the pub is included with your ticket, with valid ID; no exceptions. No guest under 21 will be permitted to consume alcohol; no exceptions. Tour availability is subject to change. Details and offerings subject to change without notice. Questions? Contact us at 216.771.4404 or glbcinfo@greatlakesbrewing.com

event.title: Christmas Ale First Pour 2026
event.description: It’s the unofficial kickoff to the holiday season in Cleveland! Join the tradition at Christmas Ale First Pour®. The first taste of the holiday seasonal classic taps exclusively at the GLBC brewpub on Thursday, October 15, 2026. Brewpub doors will open promptly at 11AM, with the first fresh keg of Christmas Ale tapped at 11:30AM after a special toast to the season. Read on to learn about our full seasonal lineup, find out how you can celebrate First Pour at Home, and enter for a chance to win a VIP Christmas Ale First Pour experience! Remember your ID! All guests must be 21 or older with a valid ID to purchase or consume alcohol. No ID, no alcohol. No exceptions. Reservations will not be accepted for First Pour, and tables will be available on a first-come, first served basis, with a three-hour limit. While supplies last. 2026 CHRISTMAS ALE FIRST POUR HIGHLIGHTS: Cleveland Carolers (10AM) Christmas Ale ceremonial keg delivery (11AM) The First Pour of Christmas Ale (11:30AM) Christmas Ale food specials (all day) Brewnuts holiday donuts available (11:30AM, while supplies last) Be the first to shop 2026 holiday merch Photo opps Entertainment: 11AM – 1:30PM: Cats on Holiday 2PM – 5PM: DJ Red-I 6PM – 9PM: Apostle Jones FIRST POUR WINTER CLOTHING DRIVE: Help us fill the bus for Sub Zero Mission, an organization providing critical cold-weather and outreach supplies to those in need. Sub Zero’s greatest needs are new or gently used: Adult men’s winter boots Adult men’s winter coats sized XL-5XL Tents Sleeping bags They are also accepting adult men’s winter hats (not homemade), winter gloves, and new socks. Not attending but want to help make an impact? Shop the Sub Zero Mission wish list and donate online here. GIFT SHOP HIGHLIGHTS: Great Lakes holiday merch hits our gift shop first on First Pour Day so you can get a head start on your holiday gifting. Be the first to shop 2026 Great Lakes holiday merch, including collaborations with Homage and Emily Roggenburk! Note: Christmas Ale will NOT be available for purchase in the gift shop during First Pour. See complete Christmas Ale release details below. FIRST POUR AT HOME PACKAGES: A limited number of Christmas Ale 1/6 bbl kegs will be available for purchase in our gift shop so you can host your own First Pour at home! You MUST make a reservation at the this link no later than October 10 to purchase a Christmas Ale keg. All reserved kegs must be picked up in person at the GLBC gift shop during your selected time slot on Thursday, October 15th. Unclaimed kegs will be made available for purchase to the public if not picked up within their time slot. Payment and valid photo ID are required at time of pick-up. All reservations must be made via the link. We are unable to accept orders over the phone or hold kegs. Keg pricing for a 1/6 bbl of Christmas Ale is $115 plus tax and $30 deposit (refundable). Keg pricing for a 1/6 bbl of Barrel Aged Christmas Ale is $195 plus tax and $30 deposit (refundable). Reserve your Christmas Ale keg here. WIN THE ULTIMATE FIRST POUR VIP EXPERIENCE: Want to make your 2026 First Pour celebration extra special for yourself and your right-hand elf? Tell us who you’d share the First Pour with and why for a chance to win a First Pour VIP Experience including a private brewery tour, lunch for two, a “sleigh” full of GLBC holiday goodies, and VIP behind-the-bar access to the first taste of the season. Enter for a chance to win here. Boxcar filled with red ornaments, You Could Be the First Pour VIP! text, and the Great Lakes Brewing Co. logo on a green plaid background. OFFICIAL FIRST POUR PARTIES: Can’t make it to Cleveland for the fun? We’re celebrating Christmas Ale First Pour in cities all over! Stay tuned to greatlakesbrewing.com/merrychristmasale for up-to-date listings of First Pour events near you, which will be added in the coming weeks and updated throughout the season. CHRISTMAS ALE RELEASE DETAILS: October 15: Christmas Ale draft-only release exclusively at the GLBC brewpub! Sorry, no growler or crowler fills on First Pour day. No reservations. October 16: The first cans, bottles, and kegs of Christmas Ale will be available for purchase exclusively at the GLBC gift shop. Sorry, we are unable to hold or reserve any beer. Gift shop opens at 10AM. October 19: Cans, bottles, and kegs of Christmas Ale will begin appearing throughout all GLBC markets. christmas_ale_honey_sq.jpg MORE UPCOMING HOLIDAY EVENTS: First Pour is just the beginning! Stay tuned for fun seasonal events including our already announced Christmas Ale VIP Brewery Experience Tours taking place select dates in October, November, andDecember. NEW HOLIDAY PARTY PACK: The Holiday Party Pack joins our seasonal lineup with a mix of four festive brews in a holiday party-themed package, perfect for celebrations. The Holiday Party Pack releases October 19 and includes three (3) cans of each: Christmas Ale: the holiday classic, brewed with ginger, cinnamon, and honey; 7.5% ABV Cran Orange Wheat: a Wheat Ale brewed with a medley of cranberry and orange; 5.5% ABV (also available in 6-packs) Cookie Exchange Milk Stout: a rotating Milk Stout now exclusive to the Holiday Party Pack, with a Snickerdoodle-inspired flavor for 2026; 5.5% ABV Snowscape Winter Lager: a NEW richly layered yet balanced Winter Lager; 6.0% ABV A 12-pack box of Great Lakes Brewing Co. Holiday Party Pack features four festive beer cans: Christmas Ale, Cookie Exchange Milk Stout, Snowscape Winter Lager, and Cran Orange Wheat, against a blurred holiday background. NEW SNOWSCAPE WINTER LAGER: In addition to its inclusion in the Holiday Party Pack, Snowscape Winter Lager releases in draft, can 12-packs, and bottle 6-packs. The slightly dark 6.0% ABV lager brings smooth and layered flavors and a cozy lodge-inspired package to our winter lineup and lager legacy. A 12-pack box and a can of Snowscape Winter Lager by Great Lakes Brewing Co. sit on a wooden barrel, with a festive, blurred background featuring string lights and greenery. BARREL AGED CHRISTMAS ALE: Barrel Aged Christmas Ale returns for a limited time in 16 oz. Can 4-Packs to make the season even brighter! Find it in the GLBC gift shop on Friday, October 16, and throughout our distribution footprint starting Monday, October 19. MORE BARREL AGED TREATS COMING SOON: Barrel Aged Blackout Stout returns in November for a limited time in 16 oz. can 4-packs. New this year, a Caramel Pecan variant of the beloved Imperial Stout also makes its way to our markets in 16 oz. can 4-packs alongside our classic legacy barrel aged offering for more holiday sipping and gifting. Caramel Pecan Blackout Stout balances rich caramel depth and toasted pecan character. Great Lakes Brewing Co. holiday party pack and seven beer cans are displayed above Upcoming Beer Releases text, with festive and colorful designs. Can’t Get Enough of Us? event.title: Come Worship! Cleveland! Tour
event.description: The “COME WORSHIP! Tour” is an invitation from Ce Ce Winans to bring together audiences of every generation, ethnicity, and denomination while worshipping Jesus as a unified congregation. Winans is excited to bring along some of the biggest worship leaders for an evening designed to be unlike anything audiences have experienced before. Joined by special guest Charity Gayle, whose anthems including “Thank You Jesus for the Blood” and “I Speak Jesus” have become modern worship staples, the tour creates a sacred space marked by faith, expectancy, and unity. Rounding out the night will be RedWorship and Terrian, two of the newest and most powerful voices in worship music.

event.title: Christmas Ale VIP Experience Tour
event.description: Want to dive even deeper into the wonderful world of brewing at Ohio’s original craft brewery? Are you a super fan of Christmas Ale? Celebrate the holiday season with us on these special Holiday VIP Experience tours, where you’ll go beyond the beer with a Brewery Exclusive Experience. Nerd out with behind-the-scenes access to our sensory lab and taste limited and small-batch brews and variations of our classic Christmas Ale you won’t find anywhere else—just like the pros do! Guests will grab their first taste of our carefully crafted beer in our Beer Symposium before venturing into the production facility for an up-close look at our brewing, cellaring, and packaging processes. Then it really gets good. Get a personal tour of our sensory lab with our Sensory Specialist and Advanced Cicerone®, and put your tastebuds to the test with samples of Christmas Ale you won’t find anywhere else! Tours last approximately 90 minutes and include a tasting of up to six Christmas Ale variations in the Sensory lab, three beer tokens for samples of your choice in our Beer Symposium, and a souvenir glass to take home! THE FINE PRINT Choose your tour date and time carefully! Payment is non-refundable, and event date and time is non-transferable. Our tours start promptly at their scheduled time; no exceptions. Guests arriving late are not guaranteed a chance to join their tour. Please allow time to find parking and arrive at least 10 minutes before your scheduled tour start time. Please be aware that buying out all of the tickets for a brewery tour does not guarantee it will be a private event for you and your guests. A limited amount of walk-up tickets are available on a first come, first served basis at the start of every public tour day. Please visit the Beer Symposium to inquire about any open availability. If you are interested in a private tour, please contact us directly at 216.325.7846 for additional details. Don’t forget your ID! Guests must be 21 or older with a valid ID to consume or purchase alcohol. Guests without a valid ID at check-in will not receive beer samples. No guest under 21 will be permitted to consume alcohol; no exceptions. This tour is for guests 21+ only. Visitors planning to visit the brewery MUST wear closed-toe shoes (i.e. boots or sneakers; no flip flops or sandals.) This is for your personal safety and the safety of our guests. Our brewery is housed in a 19th century building with narrow spaces and multiple stairwells. Be aware that breweries are hot and loud, especially in packaging areas and during the summer months. Tour availability is subject to change. Details and offerings subject to change without notice. Questions? Contact us at 216.771.4404 or glbcinfo@greatlakesbrewing.com.

event.title: 2026 Crafted History: The Last Voyage: Remembering the Edmund Fitzgerald
event.description: Join us for The Last Voyage: Remembering the Edmund Fitzgerald, a presentation honoring the crew of the Edmund Fitzgerald and remembering the ship’s final voyage. The evening’s talk will highlight the building and career of the iconic freighter, its impact on Great Lakes cities like Cleveland, the events of its last voyage, and explore the lasting legacy of its sinking in the Great Lakes region. The presentation will take place November 9, 10, and 11. Seating opens at 5:30 PM, with the presentation beginning at 6 PM and concluding at 7:14 PM, followed by a moment of silence. During the event, $1 from every pint of Edmund Fitzgerald Porter sold will be donated to the Great Lakes Shipwreck Museum.

event.title: Christmas Ale VIP Experience Tour
event.description: Want to dive even deeper into the wonderful world of brewing at Ohio’s original craft brewery? Are you a super fan of Christmas Ale? Celebrate the holiday season with us on these special Holiday VIP Experience tours, where you’ll go beyond the beer with a Brewery Exclusive Experience. Nerd out with behind-the-scenes access to our sensory lab and taste limited and small-batch brews and variations of our classic Christmas Ale you won’t find anywhere else—just like the pros do! Guests will grab their first taste of our carefully crafted beer in our Beer Symposium before venturing into the production facility for an up-close look at our brewing, cellaring, and packaging processes. Then it really gets good. Get a personal tour of our sensory lab with our Sensory Specialist and Advanced Cicerone®, and put your tastebuds to the test with samples of Christmas Ale you won’t find anywhere else! Tours last approximately 90 minutes and include a tasting of up to six Christmas Ale variations in the Sensory lab, three beer tokens for samples of your choice in our Beer Symposium, and a souvenir glass to take home! THE FINE PRINT Choose your tour date and time carefully! Payment is non-refundable, and event date and time is non-transferable. Our tours start promptly at their scheduled time; no exceptions. Guests arriving late are not guaranteed a chance to join their tour. Please allow time to find parking and arrive at least 10 minutes before your scheduled tour start time. Please be aware that buying out all of the tickets for a brewery tour does not guarantee it will be a private event for you and your guests. A limited amount of walk-up tickets are available on a first come, first served basis at the start of every public tour day. Please visit the Beer Symposium to inquire about any open availability. If you are interested in a private tour, please contact us directly at 216.325.7846 for additional details. Don’t forget your ID! Guests must be 21 or older with a valid ID to consume or purchase alcohol. Guests without a valid ID at check-in will not receive beer samples. No guest under 21 will be permitted to consume alcohol; no exceptions. This tour is for guests 21+ only. Visitors planning to visit the brewery MUST wear closed-toe shoes (i.e. boots or sneakers; no flip flops or sandals.) This is for your personal safety and the safety of our guests. Our brewery is housed in a 19th century building with narrow spaces and multiple stairwells. Be aware that breweries are hot and loud, especially in packaging areas and during the summer months. Tour availability is subject to change. Details and offerings subject to change without notice. Questions? Contact us at 216.771.4404 or glbcinfo@greatlakesbrewing.com.
